visualRegression.method: Deterministic screenshots plus structural geometry assertions
visualRegression.tolerance: 1 CSS pixel for clipping; no bitmap anti-aliasing diff threshold

defects.expected: No remote font or renderer dependency.
defects.actual: The PDF HTML unconditionally linked to Google Fonts.
defects.fix: Removed the remote Google Fonts injection; local/system typography remains unchanged.
defects.regression: Source assertion plus browser request/resource logging.

defects.expected: Reject project data that does not match its declared checksum.
defects.actual: Compatibility validation accepted a modified payload when schema compatibility passed.
defects.fix: Validate declared checksums while retaining support for legacy packs without a checksum.
defects.regression: Unit test and offline browser alert assertion.

defects.fixtureBlock: Balanced General Journal and structured statements
defects.expected: Retain accounting rows, headings, amounts, and totals.
defects.actual: Structured accounting blocks degraded to their title or plain block text.
defects.fix: Added shared structured accounting rows, Markdown tables, and native DOCX tables.
defects.regression: Fixture export unit assertions and downloaded artifact checks.

defects.expected: Allow pagination, preserve rows, and repeat column headings.
defects.actual: A blanket break-inside rule attempted to keep the entire 64-row journal together.
defects.fix: Allow long journals to paginate, repeat table headers/footers, and keep individual rows intact.
defects.regression: Computed print-geometry checks and selected-page PDF evidence.

defects.expected: Boxed answers retain a tight visible border.
defects.actual: The MathML-only PDF path omitted the KaTeX box decoration.
defects.fix: Apply a shrink-to-fit border only to exported MathML generated from boxed source.
defects.regression: Unit markup assertion and selected-page PDF evidence.
